items.text: takes the long way round when the satnav says turn left
talks to the car and has given it a name
sings every song on the radio at full volume
says I'll just drive, then ends up driving everyone
has collected more parking tickets than miles
checks the mirror eleven times in one minute
adjusts the seat for ages, then never moves it again
uses the horn as a hello
keeps every petrol receipt for the taxes
avoids the motorway but drives across the country anyway
keeps a snack compartment with exactly one biscuit inside
says I'll drive, then gets lost in the car park
sets the satnav voice to a proper accent and never reverts
hits every red light and claims it's a skill
stops at every car wash on the way home
argues with traffic lights as if they can hear
keeps a jar of old coins for toll roads
won't let anyone else touch the aux cable
brakes like they're carrying eggs in every situation
parks across two spaces to be safe
says we're almost there at the start of every journey
chats through the window with the car next to them in a jam
stops for a photo at every view, even when already late
drives like it's the last lap of Monza on a Sunday morning
still has the air freshener from 2015 hanging up
eats a full sandwich during a traffic jam
takes the bus once and calls it an adventure
picks the fastest queue in the car park and always loses
honks at pigeons
reverses into the same bin every single week
turns every journey into a quiz for the passengers
has never once checked the spare tyre
leaves the car in the wrong spot at the station three times
counts out loud at every zebra crossing
blames the sun visor for every mistake
